target.tenant: inherited from the source AgentRegistry row

authority.service: re-reads the current User row, requires active status, permits the agent owner or ADMIN+, and claims status/is_active/role/raw tenant in the publication transaction
authority.source_binding: exact source AgentRegistry id/tenant/owner/workspace/name/description/category/specialty/status/configuration guarded no-op UPDATE
authority.zero_match: effect=none; no listing/audit; peer state preserved

routes.effect: insert one AgentTemplate listing plus one AuditLog receipt in the same transaction
routes.packaging: existing AgentMarketplaceService.package_agent_for_sale rules: credentials stripped, PII redacted, entities tokenized, approved playbooks and verified_record included
routes.gates: marketplace-managed agents refused; paid listings require at least one achieved goal run
routes.replay: same operation/material -> already_applied; changed -> 409; missing/different listing -> committed_unverified

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id agent-marketplace:publish:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw system prompt, configuration, playbook, memory bundle, credential, secret, SQL parameter or exception text in the receipt or logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session; audit fields and target listing digest must match

result_states.effect_unknown: 503 effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception text

parallel_writers.route: sole verified publisher for the local listing
parallel_writers.AgentMarketplaceService.package_agent_fo: retained; internal commit=false path and exact source snapshot for the verified route
parallel_writers.AgentRegistry: source row is guarded by exact material CAS
parallel_writers.AgentTemplate: listing row inserted once per operation
parallel_writers.remote push/install: out of scope; external SaaS effect routes
